description: Department of Local Government - Northern Province - Details of new Chairman for the Valuttithurai Urban Council in Northern Province
categorisation: This gazette notice announces the election result and declaration of a new Chairman for the Valvettithurai Urban Council, specifically under the Local Authorities Elections (Amendment) Act. It contains details about the electoral process, the meeting convened for the election, and the declaration of the elected official, making it clearly related to electoral processes and results.
